required.name: git
required.why: reads the local working-tree diff under review

optional.name: gh
optional.why: fetch a GitHub PR diff + existing review comments
optional.degrade: skip remote-PR fetch; review the local diff only

optional.name: glab
optional.why: fetch a GitLab MR diff + existing discussion threads
optional.degrade: skip remote-MR fetch; review the local diff only

optional.name: hindsight
optional.why: recall prior review conventions + sibling-MR context
